title: DogfoodSessionFindings
description: Structured output for one analyzed dogfood session. Produced by scripts/dogfood/dogfood-analyze.sh via `claude -p --json-schema`. Severity and QUANTS follow dogfood/rubric.md and .claude/skills/analyze-session/SKILL.md.

case_id.description: The DF-NNN case id this session ran.

summary.description: One-paragraph session summary: task, whether it succeeded, headline friction, rough counts (vspec attempts, explicit --format=agent, direct spec edits, suggested_next_actions seen).

task_succeeded.description: Did the agent complete the case's stated task at all (regardless of friction)?

metrics.description: Optional rough counts pulled from the digest.

findings.description: Zero or more findings. Empty array means a clean session for this case.

severity.description: P0 corruption/contract break; P1 agent-recovery/core-workflow bug; P2 polish/process.

evidence.description: Exact digest line/section, command, and error text grounding this finding. No evidence => not a finding.

root_cause_area.description: Responsible code/docs area, e.g. apps/api/src/http, apps/cli/src, packages/contracts/src, apps/api/src/application/ai-guide.ts, docs/07-cli-spec.md, apps/app, apps/www.

recommendation.description: Concrete direction: API/CLI/contract fix, guide/help fix, sync/file-format fix, or deferred product decision.

routing.description: Who should build the fix per existing routing: 'claude' for presentation (apps/app, apps/www); 'codex' (TDD) otherwise.
